pure-announcement.rationale: Coverage of a durable pattern, which the rubric explicitly does not disqualify.

duplicate.rationale: No agent-maintained-wiki concept exists in this corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The pattern traces to Karpathy's public gist, which the piece links.

durability.rationale: The pattern itself — an LLM incrementally building and maintaining a persistent wiki as compounding memory, instead of per-session retrieval — is architecture-level and stands independent of who popularised it.

actionability.rationale: Secondhand coverage wrapped in course marketing; the primary gist is the actionable artifact and this summary adds little procedure.
